notices.trigger: Every home improvement contract for a price over $500, wherever signed; the right runs from the day the customer receives a copy
notices.format: Conspicuous notice printed in at least 10-point bold-faced type; contractor name, address and phone filled in
notices.support: It applies to EVERY home improvement contract over $500, not only door-to-door sales, and the clock runs from receipt of the copy, not from signing.
notices.summary_row: Written contract over $500, contents, three business day cancellation, "NOTICE TO CONSUMER"
notices.hold_reason: New Jersey is held: the statute copy is an unofficial courtesy copy revised 2/21/13 that could not be checked against the Legislature, the Division phone number conflicts between two official sources, and the block is the whole section with contract-content rules around the notice.
